findings.title: single trailing zero accepted as CONFIRMED (no observation after zero)
findings.review_expectation: a distinct status for insufficient observation, not CONFIRMED

findings.title: irregular sampling: median dt presented as resolution, real transition bracket (1.2, 5] not reported
findings.review_expectation: report the adjacent timestamps bracketing the transition, i.e. (1.2, 5.0]

findings.title: rise_time_10_90 returns a latency although the 10% crossing is not in the record
symmetric ripple threshold rejects a large improvement

observed.criterion: |delta| <= 0.05 (5 percentage points of relative ripple) at cadence >= 40 rpm; OPEN/wider

findings.review_expectation: directional criterion: lower relative ripple is better, never penalised for being better

findings.title: justification states 20-30% where the real figure is ~52%
findings.review_expectation: corrected arithmetic or a different criterion altogether

findings.title: pp<0.5 flags a perfect signal as saturated and misses real clipping
findings.review_expectation: limiting decided by real cap/floor/limit evidence; flatness informational only, never an exclusion

findings.title: saturation_flags unused by extractor and no computed bias in results
findings.review_expectation: real limit evidence consumed by the extractor and a computed bias against an explicit reference

findings.title: floor-above-profile case labelled cap-limited although the floor exceeds the profile cap

observed.label: REPRODUCED audit finding: window30/180/360 rows identical for the tested tuning

findings.review_expectation: state that the floor (assist_min_iq_pct) overrides the profile cap (max_iq_pct)

findings.title: negative runner test relocates the runner, so it fails on import instead of the native/RequiredCaseFailed path
findings.review_expectation: isolate only the OUTPUT; reach RequiredCaseFailed / the real native exit code; a missing import must FAIL the test

findings.title: only RequiredCaseFailed is caught, and no incomplete marker is written before the first case
findings.review_expectation: any preparation/build/serializer failure must also leave incomplete state; a previous complete manifest must not survive as the apparent new result

findings.title: required comparisons are recorded but never checked before run_complete=true
findings.review_expectation: a false required comparison must fail the run

findings.title: extractor accepts a manifest that is complete yet contains a required ERROR case
findings.review_expectation: reject the contradictory manifest with a nonzero exit

findings.title: inventory promotes reading test files to a completed safety proof
findings.review_expectation: claims limited to the module read; distinguish exists / read / executed

findings.title: sensor_invalid claims no test forces torque_sensor_valid; fw100_extended_boost_host.c:200-201 already does
findings.review_expectation: separate PAS-quadrature invalid / pas_sensor_valid / torque_sensor_valid and cite the partial boost coverage

findings.title: claims Controller Lab is the only CSV source, and uses Walk to justify low-cadence tolerance
findings.review_expectation: check sim/l4 and sim/replay CSV emitters; drop the Walk-based justification
